> In the 1970s, a more colloquially vivid term was introduced in the animal behavior literature to explain this phenomenon, the sneaky fucker strategy. Female mimicry is one manifestation of this behavior. This occurs when some males of a species either look or act like females of that species to avoid being attacked by dominant guarding males, and in doing so they can sneak mating opportunities.63
